items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The guy who came in I think was Thurman Reeves... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, something like that.

ctx.x: No, I just, I, no, somebody came in with some, uh, some kind of artifacts made, made out of ballast. Mm-hm.
The guy who came in I think was Thurman Reeves who had that, well he had a doorknob and you could peep through the keyhole, you remember? And then he had the newel post.
Yeah, something like that. But Greenwood and I went over and there wasn't an awful lot to rip off except wallpaper and a couple of panes of fancy bathroom glass.
